summary.zh-CN: 上传流水、账面与报销单即可开始：对账差异清单、报销合规核对、月结清单与单据索引，每条差异附行号与精确差额；只出清单与核对意见，不付款、不改账、不做税务结论。
summary.en: Start from bank statements, ledgers and expense claims: reconciliation discrepancy lists, expense policy checks, month-end close checklists and voucher indexes, every difference with row numbers and exact amounts; lists and review notes only, never payments, ledger changes or tax conclusions.

now.zh-CN: 银行流水与账面逐条匹配，差异分已匹配、金额差异、日期差异、单边未达、疑似重复五类并做合计勾稽
now.en: Match bank lines to ledger entries, classify differences as matched, amount, date, one-sided or suspected duplicate, and check totals

now.zh-CN: 报销单逐条对照制度条款，只记符合、不符合、材料未提及，标注疑似重复与拆分
now.en: Check expense claims clause by clause, recording only compliant, non-compliant or not mentioned, and flag suspected duplicates and splits

now.zh-CN: 月结事项标已完成、未完成、无法确认并附依据，做科目余额表与子表的算术勾稽
now.en: Mark close items done, not done or cannot confirm with evidence, and run arithmetic checks on the trial balance and schedules

now.zh-CN: 核对表格合计、币种、借贷方向与含税口径；把单据关联到账目条目并统计覆盖率
now.en: Verify table totals, currencies, debit/credit direction and tax definitions; link vouchers to ledger entries with coverage statistics

needs.zh-CN: 银行流水或支付平台账单、账面明细、报销单与发票影像、报销制度、科目余额表与月结子表
needs.en: Bank statements or payment platform exports, ledger details, expense claims with invoice images, the expense policy, trial balance and close schedules

needs.zh-CN: 对账期间、容忍规则、正负号与借贷方向约定、适用制度版本
needs.en: Reconciliation period, tolerance rules, sign and debit/credit conventions, applicable policy version

needs.zh-CN: 付款、调账、审批与税务处理由你在财务系统内完成或交专业人士判断
needs.en: Payments, adjustments, approvals and tax treatment are done by you in the finance system or judged by a professional

permissions.zh-CN: 只读取你本次提供的文件，不接入银行账户或财务系统
permissions.en: Reads only the files you provide; no bank account or finance system access

permissions.zh-CN: 需你确认才会做：对外发送清单、写入财务系统或共享账套、正式通过或驳回报销、起草付款或调账建议
permissions.en: Only with your confirmation: sending lists externally, writing to finance systems or shared ledgers, formally approving or rejecting claims, drafting payment or adjustment suggestions

permissions.zh-CN: 产出中不保留银行卡完整卡号、身份证号等敏感字段
permissions.en: Full bank card numbers, ID numbers and other sensitive fields are not kept in the output

conditions.zh-CN: 2026-09-25 已用真实模型（DeepSeek deepseek-flash，隔离的测试环境）验证：对账差异清单、报销合规核对、月结清单三个模板按合成样例产出结构与期望一致，勾稽差额（200.00 / 1,000.00）与报销不符合项（6 条）与期望完全相同；对账差异清单两轮中有一轮把一笔单边未达归错侧并如实报「勾稽不平」后停止，分类结果仍需本人逐条复核。
conditions.en: Verified with a real model (DeepSeek deepseek-flash, isolated test environment) on 2026-09-25: reconciliation differences, expense policy check and month-end checklist matched the expected structure on synthetic samples; tie-out differences (200.00 / 1,000.00) and the six expense findings matched exactly. In one of two reconciliation runs a one-sided item landed on the wrong side and the run reported an unbalanced tie-out and stopped; classifications need line-by-line review by the owner.

conditions.zh-CN: Stripe、飞书、钉钉等连接为可选项，本版不内置。
conditions.en: Stripe, Lark, DingTalk and other connections are optional and not bundled in this version.

conditions.zh-CN: 对账协作员只出差异清单与核对意见；付款、调账、审批与税务结论由你作出。
conditions.en: The role produces discrepancy lists and review notes only; payments, adjustments, approvals and tax conclusions are yours.
